instructions.title: How to Use
instructions.step1: Upload an Image: Click the upload area or drag and drop your image file
instructions.step2: Click to Extract Colors: Click anywhere on the image to extract the color at that point
instructions.step3: View Pantone Match: The closest matching Pantone color will be displayed with a color swatch and code
instructions.step4: Drag to Reposition: Click and drag any color swatch or sampling point to move it freely
instructions.step5: Filter Colors: Click "Color Filter" to select specific Pantone systems and card types for matching
instructions.step6: Customize Display: Click "Settings" to adjust swatch size and font sizes to your preference
instructions.step7: Add Multiple Points: Click multiple locations to create a color palette from your image
instructions.step8: Export Image: Click "Export Image" to download the annotated image with all color labels
instructions.step9: Export JSON: Click "Export JSON" to save color point data with coordinates for later use
instructions.step10: Import JSON: Click "Import JSON" to restore previously saved color points and their positions
